name: Default
shortDescription: Open-source design and prototyping platform with real-time collaboration, PostgreSQL storage, an exporter, the admin console and the MCP server.

alerts.message: Public registration is open and email verification is off, so anyone who reaches the URL can sign up. Create your accounts, then add disable-registration to PENPOT_FLAGS. Emails are written to the backend logs until you add enable-smtp to PENPOT_FLAGS and fill in the PENPOT_SMTP_* variables.
